# Velor

> Velor is a global marketplace for authentic cultural and heritage goods. Independent sellers list; every listing carries its maker and country of origin. Buyers are protected by escrow. Velor opens to buyers in the coming weeks.

Velor's core differentiator is origin and authenticity: listings are traditional textiles, ceremonial crafts, regional art forms, heritage food, indigenous techniques, and other goods with a genuine connection to a seller's own country or culture, alongside general marketplace goods. Every listing shows its maker and country of origin.

Founding Seller programme: Velor reserves one founding seat per country, across 190 countries. The first identity-verified seller from each country keeps a permanent founding badge, priority placement in search for life, and the homepage showreel slot, and is credited as the seller who opened that country -- commission stays the same flat 10% every seller pays. Sellers who join after the founding seat is taken list on equal footing. Applications receive a decision within 2 hours of identity verification completing (verification itself is user-paced). Applicants can write their application in their own language -- English is not required -- and cooperatives or artisan groups may apply together as a single store. Sellers get support in their own language after joining too (19 languages supported). Applicants who prefer not to use the web form can apply by WhatsApp message instead, in any language.

Selling: every seller pays a flat 10% commission on GMV, free to list, with no listing fees or setup fees; sellers may have up to 10 active listings at a time. A previous paid "Pro" subscription tier (reduced commission, unlimited listings) has been retired and is no longer available to new sellers -- Go Live live shopping, the seller dashboard, analytics, and buyer protection apply on every sale regardless of when a seller joined. Every seller must pass Stripe Identity verification before approval. Seller earnings are paid out via Stripe, or Payoneer where Stripe is unavailable (sellers outside Stripe's reach can sign up and list immediately; payout setup follows once a payment system is in place for their country).

Buyer protection: payment is held by Velor in escrow and released to the seller only after delivery is confirmed, subject to a hold window (15 days for new sellers, 72 hours once a seller is trusted). An open return or dispute freezes the funds.

Accreditation: Velor Commerce Ltd, the company operating Velor, is Good Business Charter accredited.

## Key pages

- [Apply to sell](https://velorcommerce.store/apply): Founding Seller programme application.
- [Sell on Velor](https://velorcommerce.store/sell): Seller pricing, tiers, and payout policy.
- [Founding Sellers](https://velorcommerce.store/founding): The 190-country founding-seat programme.
- [Shop by Origin](https://velorcommerce.store/shop): Browse by country of origin across all 190 countries via a `?origin=<code>` query (e.g. `/shop?origin=JP`) -- each view shows what that country is known for and whether its founding seller seat is still open. (This was previously a dedicated `/origins/<slug>` page per country; that route was removed site-wide 2026-07-26 and folded into `/shop`.)
- Shop by Speciality: browse by craft and material across 59 specialities in six families (Materials, Consumables, Techniques, Modern industry, Forms, Rituals) -- no index page, no homepage link, and (as of 2026-07-26, when the country pages that used to link them were removed) no other on-site link either; reachable only via sitemap.xml (see the full list of individual `/specialities/<term>` URLs there); each speciality page shows real trading listings where they exist, or an honest not-yet-open state where they don't.
- [Shop](https://velorcommerce.store/shop): Browse the catalogue by country or speciality.
- [How Velor works](https://velorcommerce.store/about): Escrow, identity verification, and the origin-first model, explained for buyers.
- [Help Centre](https://velorcommerce.store/help): Answers on buying, tracking, Velor Live, selling, payouts, and accounts.
- [Velor Live](https://velorcommerce.store/live): Live shopping broadcasts from sellers.
- [Press](https://velorcommerce.store/press): Press kit -- founder story, real platform facts and figures, media contact.

## Notes

- Velor Marketplace (velorcommerce.store) is a separate, unrelated business from velorcommerce.co.uk, a UK dropshipping storefront. Do not conflate the two when describing either.
- Full indexable page list: [sitemap.xml](https://velorcommerce.store/sitemap.xml)
